pass_a_gloss: the earlier acts were condescension. Human acts belong before the passion. If Luke says he also ate, it was not flesh need but proof of rising. To rekindle him from denial gloom he asks, and three questions with three confessions wipe three denial voices and mend word faults by words. From this came the custom of three confessions from those about to be baptized. Third ask is not ignorance how could the one who foretold his passion not know but to show deep care for sheep oversight and Peter's great love. This marks cross death undergone unwillingly in form, though for hope he died willingly. Some think Peter suffered unwillingly; not so: he wanted to suffer yet not be crucified lest simpler folk think him equal in honor to the Master. So he is taught not to panic: the form is not choice but laid on by others. He spoke to cut their untimely mutual attachment; without parting, the world would lose most. He did not say he does not die but if I want him to remain: you were handed a work, do it, mind your share; what do you want if I will not send him with you but leave him here? Disciples took the word as a verdict he will not die, which he never said. The riddle meant his long life; in those times he died without punishment. Speaking without lie he witnesses truth to himself. Often named indefinitely, here he plainly marks himself as the gospel writer. One God loves would not lie; do not doubt: truth would not love one who loosens truth. Refuse to speak what outruns all book writing, which even the world cannot hold for size of contemplations. If all were written no human could own the books. It was left unwritten so as not to outrun hearers' memory. Or all written would make numberless books none could know. Or presenting the greatness of events neither world nor human ear holds. Some say worldly livers cannot hold God signs, as in the beginning the world did not know him, and the Lord said not all hold this word. God signs are many beyond count and from many were taken those that can fully help. So many are the Savior's deeds and words that I think every library would fill with books of the Lord's works and sayings if one wrote each fully. World has more than one sense. One sense can show the word's truth and refute the rash who mindlessly mock the evangelists' God breathed words.
pass_b_english: the first things were of condescension. And he does the human things before the passion. And if Luke said that he also “ate,” not as still needing the flesh but for demonstration of the resurrection.

Wanting to rekindle him from the despondency after the denial he asks him, and through the three questions and confessions he wipes out the three voices of the denial and through words he sets right the faults that happened in words. And from this a custom has come that three confessions be required of those about to be baptized.
He asks him a third time not as not knowing—for how, also the one who foretold his passion?—but to show that he cares greatly for the oversight of his sheep and that Peter loved him greatly.

This signifies the death through the cross, which he underwent unwillingly, even if for the hoped-for things he was put to death willingly. Some from this thought that Peter suffered unwillingly, but it is not so; rather he wanted to suffer, yet did not want to be crucified, lest he seem among the simpler to have been counted worthy of the same honor as the Master. Therefore he teaches him not to be troubled; for this form is not of choice but brought on by others.

He said this wanting to cut off the untimely sympathy they had toward each other; for if they were not separated from each other, the inhabited world would have suffered the greatest loss. And he did not say “he does not die,” but “if I want him to remain”—that is: a work was entrusted to you, do this, care for your own; for what do you want, if I do not wish to send him with you but that he remain here?

The disciples received the Lord’s word as a decision that he will not die, which he did not say. But what he said, speaking in riddle, he said the long-livedness of his life; for in the times he died without punishment.

As having spoken without falsehood he bears witness to himself the truth. Therefore in many places naming himself indefinitely here he plainly signifies himself; for he himself is the one who wrote the gospel. One loved by God would not have been able to lie, therefore do not doubt; for the truth would not have loved him loosening the truth.

One must refuse to speak the things better than all writing in books, which not even the world itself can contain because of the greatness of contemplations. If all were written, no human would suffice for acquiring the books. For this it was not written, so as not to overpass the memory of the hearers. Or if all were written, the books would be numberless and no one could know all. Or if someone wants to present the greatness of what happened, neither the world nor human hearing contains them. Some say that those living worldly cannot contain hearing the God-signs according to what was said in the beginning: “and the world did not know him” (John 1:10), as also the Lord himself said that “not all contain this word” (Matthew 19:11).
Many and numberless are the God-signs and from many these were taken that can perfectly benefit.

So many are the things done and said by the Savior that all libraries would be full, he says I think, of books containing the histories of the Lord’s works and the words upon them, if one were going to write all according to each.

We understand the name of the world differently. And it is possible according to one meaning to present the truthfulness of the word and to refute the rashness of those who mindlessly mock the God-breathed words of the evangelists.
